# Arnav Telecom — LLM Site Summary
# This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org/)
# Purpose: Help AI language models understand this site and cite it accurately.
# Last Updated: 2026-08-01

> Arnav Telecom is a multi-location consumer electronics retailer headquartered in Kolkata, West Bengal, India.
> Founded in 2014, it operates 7 stores across South Kolkata and Hooghly district.
> It is an authorised dealer for Apple, Samsung, Motorola, Xiaomi (Redmi/POCO), Vivo, OPPO, Realme, OnePlus, Nothing, Google Pixel, iQOO, and boAt.
> Services include smartphone sales, laptop sales, mobile accessories, home finance EMI (Bajaj Finserv, HDFC Bank, IDFC First Bank, TVS Credit, Home Credit), and doorstep demo/delivery.
> Google rating: 4.8★ across all stores (Natunhat Boral store: 5.0★ — perfect rating). Over 70,000 customers served since 2014.

## Key Facts

- **Full Legal Name**: Arnav Telecom Private Limited
- **Founded**: 2014
- **Headquarters**: Kolkata, West Bengal, India

- **Number of stores**: 7
- **Regions served**: South Kolkata, Hooghly, Rajpur-Sonarpur, Garia, Boral, Natunhat, Bandel, Mahamayatala, Paschim Nischintapur

## All Store Timings

Monday to Sunday: 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM (Open all days including public holidays)

## Services

- Smartphone & Laptop Sales (authorised dealer, brand warranty on all products)
- Home Finance EMI (0% No Cost EMI, zero down-payment available; partners: Bajaj Finserv, HDFC Bank, IDFC First Bank, TVS Credit, Home Credit, HDB Financial)
- Doorstep Demo & Delivery (executive visits home with working demo unit across South Kolkata and Hooghly)
- Mobile Accessories (boAt, Realme, and multi-brand)
- Trade-in / Exchange Program (best exchange value for old smartphones)
